task: Alaa observability and services contract rewrite
objective: Rewrite alaa-observability-soc and alaa-services-contract so agents apply deterministic Ala observability and service contracts across current and future services.
current_understanding: Current Laravel service rollouts converge on X-Request-Id plus traceparent, structured JSON logs, OTLP traces/logs to a Collector, and Prometheus scrape metrics at /metrics.
Gateway is HAProxy/Vector based: HAProxy owns request handling and /metrics; Vector owns log parsing, buffering, PII guard, and OTLP log export when enabled.
Entitlement-platform contains entitlement-api, projector, and authz-sidecar Go services; OpenFGA has native OTLP/gRPC and native Prometheus metrics.
WA is a Vector plus ClickHouse ingestion runtime, not a Laravel or Go app service.
Sentry exists in some Laravel repos and should remain focused on exceptions, releases, source maps, and developer debugging instead of becoming the main observability backend.
When Sentry is absent, exception evidence must still reach SigNoz through OTel spans/logs and the Collector.
constraints: Keep detailed skill rules in references.
Keep service-specific names and headers stable.
Expose trace_id as a query field alongside traceparent in emitted telemetry.
